$meta.source: Pulled from the user's Claude Design project "accelance design system" (claude.ai/design, project 019dd881-a2db-7d6c-921c-ac19b85cf9e3) via the DesignSync tool on 2026-07-27.
$meta.note: These are the real, user-approved brand tokens — not a Claude Code guess. Two items remain pending per the source system itself: see $meta.openItems. Do not add colors/sizes outside this file (CLAUDE.md hard rule 2).

openItems: Typeface: Inter Bold/Regular is the current working default; Arial is the corporate fallback for environments without Inter. Serif alternatives (Cambria, Century Schoolbook) were proposed but require sign-off — not adopted.
Vector logo: only an interim raster PNG exists (assets/logo-*.png). A true vector (.svg/.ai/.eps) is still needed for production use.

Primary blue value: the source docs flag a discrepancy — pixel-sampling of real decks measured #1A6FC4, but the design system's confirmed working value (and the one in this file) is #0052CC. Re-verify against the live accelance.io site before final production sign-off if that matters for this app.

A dark theme (base #07111F, accent #4E7DFF) was proposed at some point but explicitly NOT adopted — no evidence backed it and it contradicts every confirmed light-themed source artifact. This tokens file intentionally has no dark-mode values. The current AI-Platform-Internal app (packages/ui) DOES have a working dark-mode toggle today (see DESIGN_SPEC.md Section 4 current-state) — whether the redesign keeps dark mode is an open question, logged in DESIGN_SPEC.md Section 9, since the brand system provides no dark palette to migrate to.

primary.usage: Primary buttons, headers, links, icons, primary actions

success.usage: Positive metrics, success states, agent-health (autonomous tier)

alert.usage: Business-value highlights, warnings. AA-compliant for large text only — never small body text on white.

compliance.usage: Compliance/risk indicators. AA-compliant for large text only — never small body text on white.

tint.usage: Card backgrounds, section tints, callout boxes, selected states

gradientBrand.usage: Covers, hero sections, section dividers ONLY — not for general UI chrome

autonomous.usage: Agent tier: fully autonomous, no human review needed

review.usage: Agent tier: human review required before/after execution

approval.usage: Agent tier: mandatory human approval before execution

agentStatus.note: This three-tier system is not optional styling — it ties directly to accelance's human-in-the-loop governance positioning. Every AI-proposed action must render as an explicit confirmation card (see components/agent/ApprovalCard); never silent auto-execution.

color.semanticRule: Colors are semantic, never decorative. Once a color is assigned a meaning (e.g. orange = business value), reuse it consistently — never reassign or cycle colors arbitrarily within the same product/document.

fontFamily.note: Inter is the current working default; Arial is the corporate fallback.

minimums.note: Never go smaller than these minimums.

radius.rule: Universal — applies to cards, buttons, inputs, images, modals. This is the one shape rule across every deliverable. No hard 0px-radius elements.

subtle.usage: Default when a shadow is needed at all — cards, dropdowns

shadow.rule: Flat/no-shadow is the default everywhere else. Use shadows sparingly, only to lift a card off a busy background.

motion.animations: Appear, with 0.2s stagger delay between items

iconography.library: Tabler Icons (outline style, 2px stroke, MIT license)
iconography.loadedVia: tokens/fonts.css webfont import, wrapped by the Icon component
iconography.style: Outline only — never filled, never mixed icon sets, no emoji/unicode-as-icon
iconography.housing: Monochrome, optionally housed in a colored circle or flat colored tile

motifs.hubAndSpoke: Radial/hub-and-spoke diagrams for 'components orbiting a central idea' content — usable anywhere
motifs.waveBanner: Curved/wave banner divider — RESERVED for one-pagers only, never in slide decks, never in app/website UI

logo.clearSpace: equal to the height of the lowercase "a" in the wordmark, on all sides
logo.never: stretch, rotate, recolor outside the brand palette, reduce opacity
